question: What paradoxical condition is described for even a wise person, who, while burning, is said to act in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence?
premises: That person is in a burning condition.
The action is described in relation to the tip of nectar.
It is also described in relation to the tip of essence.
inference: Even a wise person, while burning, engages in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The precise practice and the purpose of this paradox are not explained in this verse alone.
plain_english: Even a wise person, burning, at the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence.
